info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Asset Securitization Retrieval API
info.description: The Asset Securitization Retrieval API allows users to access detailed information about specific asset securitizations. This endpoint is invaluable for treasury professionals and financial analysts who require insights into securitized assets for assessment and decision-making purposes. By utilizing a unique identifier, users can retrieve comprehensive data related to the asset securitization, including its structure, performance metrics, and associated documentation. This API supports informed investment strategies and compliance reporting within the banking sector.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about a specific asset securitization identified by its unique identifier. It provides comprehensive data, including but not limited to financial performance, structural features, and relevant documentation.

requestBody.description: Request body containing the necessary parameters for retrieving asset securitization information related to RES-100045. This includes specific filters and data points required by the API to process the request accurately.

200.description: Successful retrieval of the requested asset securitization details.
